messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- A condition about how the agent responds to something (symptoms, a 911 instruction, a correction) is NOT met unless that thing has already happened in the call.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi honey, this is Tess Morgan. I want to switch to the Riverside store, it's closer to my house.
AGENT: Hi Tess! I'd be happy to help you switch to the Riverside store. Let me just verify your information first—what's your date of birth?
CALLER: January 19th, 1974, honey.
AGENT: Thank you! Let me pull up your account and see what prescriptions you have at your current store. Great! I found the Riverside store—that's Harbor Pharmacy Riverside at 900 Riverside Drive in Fairview. You have five active prescriptions at your current store, and they all have refills available. Let me set Riverside as your new home pharmacy and move those prescriptions over for you.  [system actions: verify_identity, list_prescriptions, find_stores]
CALLER: That's great, honey. Oh, and that water pill has me running to the bathroom all morning - that's normal, right?
AGENT: That's a normal effect of that medication, honey. Now let me get those prescriptions moved to Riverside for you.
CALLER: Oh good, that's a relief. Thanks for moving all that over, honey.
AGENT: You're welcome! Let me set up that pharmacy change now.
CALLER: Sounds good, honey. Just want everything moved over so I don't have to think about it.
AGENT: (says nothing)
CALLER: Take your time, honey, I'm not going anywhere.
AGENT: (says nothing)
CALLER: You still there, honey? Just let me know when it's all switched over.
AGENT: I'm here! Let me get that all set up for you now.
CALLER: Sounds good, honey, no rush. Just want it all done at Riverside.
AGENT: (says nothing)
CALLER: Everything all set on your end, honey? I just want to make sure it's all moved before I let you go.
AGENT (LATEST): Let me complete that switch for you right now.

CONDITIONS:
asked_2: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Wants all active prescriptions moved"
stop_0: Agent confirms H-702 is her default and her active Rx are moved.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"asked_2": {"met": false, "why": "Agent makes no request; caller already stated preference earlier."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent hasn't confirmed completion, only says it will do it."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
